{{Use British English|date=April 2014}}
The '''1971–72 Football League Cup''' was the 12th season of the [[Football League Cup]], a knock-out competition for England's top 92 [[association football|football]] clubs. The tournament started on 17 August 1971 and ended with the final at Wembley on 4 March 1972.
[[Stoke City F.C.|Stoke City]] won the tournament after defeating [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]] in the final at [[Wembley Stadium (1923)|Wembley Stadium]], London.
Entry for all football league clubs became compulsory this season.

==Calendar==
Of the 92 teams, 36 received a [[Bye (sports)|bye]] to the second round (teams ranked 1st–36th in the [[1970–71 Football League]]) and the other 56 played in the first round. Semi-finals were [[Two-legged tie|two-legged]].

==Final==
{{main|1972 Football League Cup Final}}
The final was held at [[Wembley Stadium (1923)|Wembley Stadium]], London on 4 March 1972.
